subject_definitions:

(S1) The woman’s facial identity is defined by Picture 2 (@图片2): preserve her facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, and recognizable identity. Picture 2 defines facial identity only. Her visible hairstyle, clothing, body styling, and physical presentation are fully defined by Picture 1 (@图片1): naturally loose dark hair and a loose blue shirt.

(S2) The man’s facial identity is defined by Picture 3 (@图片3): preserve his facial structure, eyes, brows, nose, lips, skin tone, and recognizable identity. Picture 3 defines facial identity only. His visible hairstyle, clothing, body styling, and physical presentation are fully defined by Picture 1 (@图片1): naturally loose long dark hair, a burgundy T-shirt, and a small adhesive bandage across the bridge of his nose.

The bedroom, black headboard, pillows, floral quilt, couple’s left-right placement, casual intimacy, direct-flash appearance, and final instant-film composition are defined by Picture 1 (@图片1). The woman remains on screen left and the man remains on screen right.

The viewpoint is the first-person optical view of an instant camera held by (S2). The camera body and the hand holding it remain beyond the image boundaries. The visible frame contains the couple, the bed, the floral quilt, and the bedroom background. Only (S2)’s extended left forearm enters naturally from the lower-right edge, establishing the selfie action.

summary:

Create an 8-second intimate drama that begins as natural live-action bedroom footage and ends as the frozen instant photograph defined by Picture 1. (S2) gently nudges (S1) with his right elbow. She reacts with restrained shyness, briefly moves away, then decides to lean in and kiss his cheek. (S2) presses the shutter outside the visible frame; a synchronized mechanical click and frontal flash freeze the moment and transform it into an instant-film photograph.

retention_analysis:

(S1) appears in Shots 1–6: fully_preserved - maintain the facial identity from Picture 2 while preserving the loose dark hairstyle, blue shirt, screen-left position, and casual styling from Picture 1.

(S2) appears in Shots 1–6: fully_preserved - maintain the facial identity from Picture 3 while preserving the loose long hairstyle, burgundy T-shirt, nose bandage, screen-right position, and casual styling from Picture 1.

The bedroom and bedding appear in Shots 1–6: fully_preserved - maintain the black headboard, pillows, floral quilt, close physical spacing, and bedroom arrangement from Picture 1.

The selfie viewpoint appears in Shots 1–6: fully_preserved - maintain the first-person instant-camera view, with the device outside the image boundaries and only (S2)’s extended left forearm visible at the lower-right edge.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1] The first frame immediately shows (S1) and (S2) reclining side by side against the black headboard beneath the floral quilt. (S1) is on screen left and (S2) is on screen right. The viewpoint sits directly in front of them, slightly above eye level, as the optical view of the instant camera. (S2)’s left forearm extends naturally toward the lens from the lower-right edge, while his left hand and the device remain beyond the frame. He looks into the lens with a small expectant smile. (S1) looks down toward the quilt with both hands resting on it. Natural live-action texture, soft warm bedside light, cool nighttime fill, and subtle arm-held micro-movement establish reality. Continue until 00:01.400.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.400, (S2) keeps his extended left forearm and the viewpoint stable. He performs one gentle inward movement with his right elbow, briefly contacting (S1)’s upper arm, then stops. Her blue sleeve compresses slightly at the contact point and the floral quilt forms a small responding fold. Her eyes glance toward him before her head turns a few degrees. She lifts her shoulders, shifts several centimeters toward screen left, and places her left palm lightly against his chest once while suppressing a shy smile. Continue until 00:02.600.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.600, (S1)’s palm remains against his chest for half a second. Her gaze moves once from his face to the lens and back. She takes one short breath, gradually relaxes her fingers, and lowers her hand onto the quilt. Her raised shoulders settle and her body stops moving away. (S2) withdraws his right elbow and waits without further prompting, maintaining his gaze toward the lens and keeping his extended left forearm steady. After a brief evaluative pause, (S1) shifts her body weight back toward him. Continue until 00:04.400.

[Shot 4] At 00:04.400, (S1) deliberately leans toward (S2), closes her eyes, and places one gentle kiss on his left cheek. Her lips and nose press softly into his cheek, creating subtle realistic skin compression. Loose strands of her hair slide between their shoulders under gravity. (S2)’s smile naturally widens while his eyes remain directed toward the lens. His left forearm becomes increasingly steady as their faces, clothing, quilt, and body positions converge on the intimate composition defined by Picture 1. Continue until 00:06.200.

[Shot 5] At 00:06.200, (S1) holds the kiss. A small visible tension passes through (S2)’s extended left forearm as his off-frame finger completes one shutter press. At the exact moment the button reaches its stopping point, a clear mechanical shutter click sounds and a frontal flash fills the frame. Both faces, loose hair strands, fabric folds, and quilt movement freeze simultaneously at the flash peak. Continue until 00:06.700.

[Shot 6] At 00:06.700, the frozen image settles into the final composition defined by Picture 1: (S1) keeps her eyes closed while kissing (S2)’s cheek, and (S2) smiles directly toward the lens. Preserve his nose bandage, her blue shirt, his burgundy T-shirt, the black headboard, pillows, and floral quilt. The natural live-action image transforms into direct-flash instant photography with slightly lifted highlights, gentle color shift, fine instant-film grain, and soft photographic falloff. A textured white instant-film border develops around the frozen image, with the handwritten date NOV 14 centered on the lower border. Hold the completed still photograph until 00:08.000.

overall_soundscape:

Quiet bedroom room tone continues from 00:00.000 to 00:06.200, with soft quilt movement, fabric friction, and faint nighttime ambience. At 00:01.400, the elbow contact produces one soft cloth-compression sound. (S1) makes one short inhale and a restrained shy laugh as she shifts away. Hair and fabric move softly as she leans closer. The kiss produces one gentle contact sound. At 00:06.200, a precise mechanical shutter click synchronizes with the frontal flash and complete image freeze. A short mechanical resonance remains beneath the final still image. No spoken dialogue.
